label: r3c4
name: lr 2.5e-3, 256 envs x 8 steps
hypothesis: This keeps r2c2 but collects each update from 256 parallel worlds over 8 steps instead of 128 worlds over 16. The update size (2048 samples), minibatch size (64) and number of updates stay the same. Each update then sees twice as many distinct designs, so gradients are less correlated. Fewer envs (64) hurt in 3 of 4 earlier worlds, which hints that more envs may help. Refuted if either seed falls below 0.92 or the mean is below r2c2's 0.949.
